1666.note: safety catalogs must be consumed by a creator, not only their own list page

_note: CLAIMED verify-step numbers. Every PR adding a verify-step MUST add its number here IN THE SAME COMMIT. Two agents claiming the same number then CONFLICT IN GIT instead of silently agreeing and reddening main afterwards.
_why: Six collisions on 2026-07-26 alone. Convention-based allocation cannot see a concurrent claimant on another branch: the clash only appears at merge, AFTER both PRs went green, and then reds every branch cut from main. A registry converts an invisible race into a merge conflict, which is where it belongs.
_how_to_claim: Pick the next free number in your band, add "<number>": "<filename>", commit it WITH the guard.
